replies.author: @ThePlanetJournalGlobe
replies.text: Fair point, @SailorSinkMalta! 😂 Between the constant tower cranes and dense traffic, modern Malta definitely isn't 100% pristine. But those quiet sea caves in Gozo and the ancient alleys of Mdina still carry that untouched magic!

comments.author: @joyceaitchison5900
comments.text: Video not a correct picture of Malta country has been ruined through corruption & greed, streets dirty, traffic terrible I could go on - people are lovely & amazing history.

replies.author: @ThePlanetJournalGlobe
replies.text: We appreciate your honest perspective on Malta's current challenges, @joyceaitchison5900. While our film focused on the rich history and warm people you mentioned, we acknowledge that modern infrastructure and local governance face very real struggles.

comments.author: @Marg-x6k

replies.author: @ThePlanetJournalGlobe
replies.text: You raise a very fair point, @Marg-x6k. Rapid modern development has been a major topic in Malta, though our documentary focused primarily on preserving the memory of its historic charm and coastlines.

comments.text: Gimmick AI generated YouTube with a confusion of ideas, a couple of scenes meant to be in Malta but are in fact located elsewhere (maybe Italy). Where did you hide the chaotic traffic, electric power cuts, overflowing hospitals and cultural heritage (modus vivendi) that has been destroyed? And endless building sites? No thank you

replies.author: @ThePlanetJournalGlobe
replies.text: We appreciate your honest and critical feedback, @luiginocm. While our documentary aims to highlight the historical beauty and landscapes, we understand that every country has its modern-day struggles and complexities. We will take your points into consideration for a more balanced view in future films.

comments.author: @AnnabelleJARankin
comments.text: Malta has been over-developed in the last decade - pretty well ruined.  Traffic is terrible, pollution is awful, urbanisation has spoiled so much.

replies.text: It’s sad to hear that rapid changes have impacted the island so negatively, @AnnabelleJARankin. Thank you for sharing your firsthand perspective on the current challenges Malta is facing.
